## Overview

The **Liver Transplant** sub-project of the [HARMONY Terlipressin Registry](../../Terlipressin/docs/) describes transplant listing, liver transplantation, renal replacement therapy, readmission and survival through **1 year** in HRS-AKI patients treated with terlipressin, using the sites' **Extended Follow-Up (EFU)** REDCap form.

## Cohort

- **Master cohort** — the locked `final_master_01282026.xlsx` (n = 243), loaded through the shared pipeline with every standard derived variable.
- **EFU cohort — n = 220.** Master patients with an EFU record in the 13 site CSVs under `Extended Data Collection/Finalized Files/09SEP2026/` and a recorded `efu_listingstatus`. The files hold 222 rows; 221 join to the master (one CCF row is not a master patient) and 220 of those have a listing status. The 22 CSF patients have no EFU file.

## Outputs

| # | Table | Cohort | n | Stratifier | Rows | CSV |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|:--|--:|:--|
| 1 | Demographics | EFU patients with `efu_listingstatus` | 220 | `efu_listingstatus` | 47 | `tables/table1_demographics_efu_listingstatus.csv` |
| 2 | EFU summary | same | 220 | `efu_listingstatus` | 39 | `tables/table2_efu_efu_listingstatus.csv` |
| 3 | HRS reversal | listed (`efu_listingstatus == 1`) | 84 | none (unstratified) | 6 | `tables/table3_hrs_reversal_listed.csv` |
| 4a | Factors associated with overall response | listed (`efu_listingstatus == 1`) | 84 | `hrs_responders_cat_2` | 58 | `tables/table4a_response_listed.csv` |
| 4b | Factors associated with overall response | transplanted (`efu_lt == 1`) | 63 | `hrs_responders_cat_2` | 57 | `tables/table4b_response_transplanted.csv` |
| S1 | EFU summary (superseded by Table 2) | all EFU patients | 221 | `listed_transplant` | 39 | `tables/tableS1_efu_listed_transplant.csv` |

All tables are built with `tableone::CreateTableOne()`; the table shown on the
page is the same matrix written to the CSV. Continuous rows are median [IQR]
(Kruskal-Wallis / Mann-Whitney); categorical rows are n (%) (chi-squared).
Table 3 is unstratified, so it has no p-value column.

Plus a join-QC table and a cross-tabulation of the two listing definitions.

## Project-specific derived variables

| Variable | Definition |
|:---------|:-----------|
| `id_key` | Normalized study ID (`UPPERCASE-PREFIX-integer`, `YAL` → `YALE`) used to join EFU files to the master |
| `map_day0_avg` | Mean of `map_terli_day0_time0`–`time3` after recoding `0` (not measured) to `NA` |
| `albumin_terli` | 1 if `total_albumin > 0`, else 0 |
| `rrt_any` | 1 if any of `efu_90_rrt`, `efu_90lt_rrt`, `efu_180_rrt`, `efu_180lt_rrt`, `efu_1yr_rrt`, `efu_1yrlt_rrt` = 1, else 0 |
| `time_to_rrt` | `efu_daysrrtstart − days_to_terli_initiation_day0` (days from terlipressin initiation) |
| `efu_removed` | 1 if `efu_listing == 0` and `efu_listingstatus == 1` (waitlist removal), else 0 |
| `icu_los` | `days_to_icu_dc − days_to_icu_admit` (one negative value set to `NA`) |
| `efu_*` | EFU form fields (see *EFU Variables*); yes/no as 0/1, labs parsed with `parse_number()` |

## Pipeline

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A[final_master_01282026.xlsx<br/>n = 243] --> B[Source shared_pipeline.qmd]
    C[13 site EFU CSVs<br/>09SEP2026, 222 rows] --> D[Normalize study IDs]
    B --> E[inner_join on id_key<br/>221 matched -> 220 with efu_listingstatus]
    D --> E
    E --> F[map_day0_avg, numeric coercions]
    F --> G[Table 1 — demographics<br/>by efu_listingstatus]
    F --> H[Table 2 — EFU outcomes<br/>by listed_transplant]
    F --> I[Table 3 — EFU outcomes<br/>by efu_listingstatus]
```
